steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Depth Study (Paper 2) is worth 50% of the GCSE and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes | Key Fact: It focuses on a shorter period in much greater detail, requiring depth of knowledge and source analysis | Key Fact: Source-based questions are central to the Depth Study — you must use sources as evidence | Key Fact: The paper may ask you to evaluate the utility of a source for a specific question

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
